minutes.headline: Sewer Commission ratified Paula Bertram as business manager and approved posting an assistant business manager job.
minutes.summary: After a public hearing with no public present, the commission approved amended sewer use regulations. It ratified Paula Bertram as sewer business manager to replace the retiring Barbara. The main debate was whether to post the assistant business manager position or create a clerical one first. Members also covered grease trap fog enforcement, the Leominster IMA renegotiation, and budget revisions.

budget_items.what_was_said: The business manager found the transfer had been calculated using revenues including one-time ARPA funds. She proposed returning to the historical percentage of revenues.
The earlier estimate of user charge growth was judged too high and reduced.
Fitchburg may raise rates each year over five years; the budget stays level funded.
A deficit of betterment fund over debt service was described, with transfers to capital reserve and reserve capacity stabilization.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to ratify Paula Bertram as sewer business manager, replacing the retiring business manager.
The commission approved the amended sewer use regulations after a public hearing at which no members of the public were present.
The commission voted to post an assistant business manager position, after discussing whether to create a clerical position first.
Members agreed to keep billing a grease trap violator a daily fee and let the violator appeal to the board.
A subcommittee of two members will work on the Leominster intermunicipal agreement, and staff will arrange a meeting with the engineering firm.

why_it_matters: Sewer use regulations and the staffing of the office that bills sewer users changed, which touches the sewer bill and how rules such as grease trap enforcement are applied.

The budget revisions discussed, including the capital reserve transfer, the user charge estimate and Fitchburg's possible yearly rate increases, shape what sewer users are asked to pay in the coming year.
watch_next: The next meeting is expected to finalize the warrant articles and take up the clerical position discussion added to the agenda.
The Leominster agreement subcommittee and the meeting with the engineering firm.
